title: MABPD: Multi-Agent Bias Probing & Detection via Structured Argument Debate
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting media bias, loaded language, and ideological framing in news articles using a multi-agent LLM pipeline. While it briefly mentions 'moral framing' as one of the 12 journalistic framing categories it tracks, the paper does not systematically study, evaluate, or benchmark religious understanding, moral judgments, or ethical reasoning in LLMs.
